[[Kaolin Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Assassin's Construct]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sunjiang District]] or [[Silent Surf]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Energy]] -5
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[Physical damage]])
